JobDescription:
You will join a lean, high-output engineering team as an AI-native full-stack engineer. This is not a maintenance role — you will be architecting and building full systems on a production platform that processes medical billing for healthcare providers. The current lead developer (Raj, based in India, 3 years with AgentAI) is overwhelmed, and you will work alongside him, CTO Kranti Deshmukh, and CEO Zorik Gordon to scale the platform. The structure is completely flat — there are no layers, no hierarchy. You will be expected to think, problem-solve, and ship independently with minimal hand-holding.


What You’ll Own

  • Architect and scale a modular, high-throughput data pipeline relying heavily on LLM orchestration, structured JSON data extraction, and complex logical evaluation gates
  • Build and enhance production features on the AI medical billing platform — not buttons and UI tweaks, but full systems (data extraction, evaluation logic, modifier systems)
  • Handle structured data pipelines, JSON schemas, OCR parsing, and API orchestration layers
  • Decouple systems cleanly — separate data extraction, evaluation, and modifier logic into regression-tested workflows
  • Ensure the platform meets healthcare compliance and security standards (HIPAA) from day one
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Codex CLI) as your primary development method to ship production-ready code at 10x speed
  • Collaborate directly with the CTO, CEO, and lead developer in a flat, no-hierarchy environment


Tech Stack

  • Frontend: React
  • Backend: Python, Node.js
  • Data: Structured JSON pipelines, OCR processing, API orchestration
  • AI/LLM: LLM orchestration, programmatic prompt engineering, autonomous terminal agents
  • AI Dev Tools: Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Codex CLI — used as primary development method, not supplementary
  • Compliance: HIPAA-compliant architecture, healthcare data security


Must-Haves

  • Up to 5 years of professional full-stack engineering experience
  • AI-native workflow — mastery of autonomous terminal agents (Claude Code), CLI-driven AI execution tools, and programmatic LLM prompt engineering. This is not optional — AI tools must be your primary coding method
  • Strong backend architecture skills (Python) paired with clean, lightweight frontend capabilities (React)
  • Experience handling structured data pipelines, JSON schemas, parsing raw input (OCR), and managing API orchestration layers
  • Architecture-first mindset — ability to decouple systems cleanly and build regression-tested workflows
  • Understanding of security and compliance standards (HIPAA preferred) — must be able to assess what the platform needs from a compliance perspective on day one
  • Ownership mindset — think, problem-solve, and ship independently. Not someone who waits for instructions.
  • Comfortable working PST hours (Los Angeles time zone) — the entire team, including India-based members, works LA hours
  • High work ethic and speed — comfortable in a rapid, high-execution environment with minimal hand-holding


Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare IT background — experience with medical billing, RCM, prior authorisation, FHIR integrations, or EHR/EMR systems
  • Experience at a healthcare startup or health tech company
  • Understanding of payer interactions and third-party healthcare data systems
  • Premier institute background (IIT, top NIT, or equivalent)
  • Startup or product company experience — NOT IT services background


Interview Process

  • Assessment Round
  • Team interview — Discussion with Kranti and the engineering team on your approach, thought process, and framework submission
  • Final round — Cultural fit and product alignment with Kranti and Zori

company.about: AgentAI is a well-funded (~$72M+ raised from Transformation Capital, EIR Partners, Slow Ventures, and Oceans Ventures), 3-year-old AI company building an end-to-end AI platform for medical billing and revenue cycle management (RCM). The platform automates the most time-consuming tasks in medical billing — data extraction, coding, claims processing, denials, and accounts receivable — delivering same-day processing for practices, hospitals, and RCM companies. AgentAI also acquires offline medical billing companies and converts them to AI-powered operations. The team is small, tight, and flat — even the CEO creates PRs and fixes bugs. Headquartered in Los Angeles with team members across India and Latin America.
company.industry: Healthcare Technology / AI / Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
